items.summary: Een volgende Champions League-dag, maar in deze VI Live volgen we ook de verrichtingen van FC Twente en Telstar in de Eredivisie en het duel tussen Chelsea en Leeds United in de League Cup. Daarnaast houden we andere belangrijke duels in het buitenland in de gaten. Voor de wedstrijd Barcelona - Feyenoord hebben we een apart liveblog .

items.title: Ronaldo weer stap dichterbij magische mijlpaal van duizend doelpunten
items.summary: De magische mijlpaal van duizend carrièredoelpunten komt langzamerhand in zicht voor Cristiano Ronaldo. De Portugese superster was woensdagavond andermaal trefzeker voor Al-Nassr, dat met 2-1 te sterk was voor Saudi Pro League-promovendus Abha. De 41-jarige Ronaldo heeft nu nog 21 doelpunten nodig.

items.title: Johan Cruijff in Camp Nou geëerd voorafgaand aan CL-duel met Feyenoord
items.summary: Feyenoord begon zijn Champions League-avontuur in Camp Nou tegen het ijzersterke Barcelona, dat met ruime cijfers won. In deze VI Live volgden we alles rond deze wedstrijd op de voet.

items.title: Odegaard strike earns Arsenal narrow victory at Napoli
items.summary: Martin Odegaard's excellent start to the season continues as the Arsenal captain scores the only goal of the match against Napoli in Naples.

items.title: Feyenoord krijgt complimenten van Flick: 'Maar dat mag niet op dit niveau'
items.summary: Barcelona was woensdagavond een paar maten te groot voor Feyenoord. Desondanks was Hansi Flick, de trainer van de Catalanen, lovend over Feyenoord en de speelstijl van de Rotterdammers. Een mooi compliment, vond Giovanni van Bronckhorst, maar dat neemt niet weg dat de nederlaag te fors was.

items.title: Cole Palmer powers Chelsea to comeback win over Leeds in nine-goal epic
items.summary: Where’s the fun in doing it the easy way? Chelsea remain chaotic at the back but can drag their opponents into horrible places. It helps, mind you, to have some assistance from the referee. Jarred Gillett and Cole Palmer? They made for a killer ­combination as Chelsea swerved embarrassment and treated Stamford Bridge to one of life’s rarities: a classic in the third round of the Carabao Cup. Gillett, a referee who always seems to be guessing when he makes key calls, was the villain as far as Leeds were concerned. They had just gone 2-0 up when Gillett altered the flow of the tie by pointing to the spot after Pep Chavarría made the most of slight contact from Daniel James. The subsequent conversion from Palmer was inevitable and from there so was the comeback from Chelsea, who rattled through four goals in 12 minutes before eventually reaching the last 16 by winning 6-3. Continue reading...

items.title: Hansi Flick: 'Feyenoord speelde fantastisch voetbal'
items.summary: Feyenoord verloor dan wel met ruime cijfers van Barcelona, maar speelde fantastisch voetbal. Dat concludeert Hansi Flick na afloop van het duel in de Champions League.

items.title: Liverpool come from behind to beat Atletico Madrid
items.summary: Alexis Mac Allister scores an emphatic winner as Liverpool began their Champions League campaign with a win over Atletico Madrid at Anfield.

items.title: Alexis Mac Allister makes his point as Liverpool fight back to defeat Atlético
items.summary: It was the time and place for Alexis Mac Allister to do his talking on the pitch and the disgruntled Liverpool midfielder delivered on cue. “Very sad” over Liverpool’s refusal to offer him a new contract, while Dominik Szoboszlai and Ryan Gravenberch were getting theirs, Mac Allister made Anfield very happy with a match-winning display against Atlético Madrid. The Argentina international, one of five World Cup finalists involved in an absorbing, delicately-poised contest, vented his frustrations in the best possible and most professional way – from behind an immaculate 20-yard strike into Jan Oblak’s goal rather than a microphone. Mac Allister believes he is playing for a new deal this season and promised to give “100% to my last day” at the pre-match press conference. He was true to his word to extend Atlético’s winless sequence against English opposition in the Champions League league phase to 11 matches. Continue reading...

items.title: Ødegaard stuns Napoli as Arsenal make winning start in Champions League
items.summary: After their record-breaking feats last year in the Champions League, Arsenal are at it again. But having been delayed along with hundreds of travelling supporters by travel chaos on Tuesday, Mikel Arteta’s side had to bide their time against Napoli until Martin Ødegaard continued his rich vein of goalscoring with the crucial strike 15 minutes from full time. Perhaps it was the fact that, at Uefa’s insistence, they were forced to wear red shorts for the first time since a Premier League game against Watford in 2022 that Arsenal were not quite at their flowing best here and missed a hatful of chances. Continue reading...

items.title: Infantino installs loyalist to oversee Caribbean as he splits Fifa management
items.summary: Critics view Fernandes job as move to shore up position Fifa says change is designed to make sport ‘truly global’ Gianni Infantino has separated Fifa’s management of the Caribbean countries from the rest of Concacaf in a move widely regarded by his opponents as an attempt to split the alliance to remove him from office. Concacaf covers North and Central America as well as the Caribbean and was previously managed as one bloc. But the Guardian has learned that the former Switzerland midfielder Gelson Fernandes, an Infantino loyalist, has been appointed as the director of member associations for the Caribbean, in addition to his position looking after Fifa’s African members. Continue reading...

items.title: Rosario ‘grabbed my bottom’ during Manchester City’s win at Porto, claims Haaland
items.summary: Forward says incident was ‘a little interesting’ Heading practice with Alf Inge helped with opener Erling Haaland has claimed Pablo Rosario “grabbed my bottom” during Manchester City’s 2-0 win at Porto on Tuesday. The incident occurred in the 92nd minute, with Haaland having scored City’s goals. The forward and midfielder grappled, went to ground and were booked after being separated. “I was really keen on a hat-trick and it seemed like he was very eager to stop me from getting it,” Haaland told Norway’s TV 2. “It was a little interesting, that – you’ll be seeing a picture where he’s grabbing my bottom. It’ll be interesting to see that picture.” Continue reading...

items.summary: Noa Lang staat nog altijd op de loonlijst van Napoli, maar een vaste basisspeler is de Nederlander er zeker niet. Ook tegen Arsenal stond hij niet in de basis. Meer nog: Lang zat zelfs niet op de bank bij Napoli en daar was een opvallende reden voor.
